infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SaveSpots uses your location to show nearby SaveBoxes and to tag a new SaveBox you submit.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SaveSpots uses the camera so you can photograph a SaveBox when you check in on it or submit a new location.
